answer: One defense is stake-bonded identity with slashing. Voting weight requires locking a bond scaled to the influence requested, so power is priced in capital, not account count. Attestations come from a random bond-weighted committee, and an identity caught signing for two conflicting accounts forfeits its bond. That is the basalt layer of the economy: flat and costly to fake. An adversary chasing the zenith of influence with ten thousand puppets must post real stake each, so cost grows linearly, not near zero. Honest agents hold a lantern: reputation accrues only while a bond is unspent.
